scope: Three consistent character families and two original top-down bosses. User-supplied fighter images are motion references.

A production-ready transparent pixel-art character sprite sheet. Exactly FOUR horizontal rows and ELEVEN evenly spaced columns: 44 separate full-body silhouettes, no touching cells. Rows top to bottom: UP (back of head, back of body, face hidden); RIGHT (face and feet point right); DOWN (front view); LEFT (face and feet point left). Columns left to right: 0 neutral standing; 1,2,3,4 four different walking steps; 5 attack ready; 6 attack windup; 7 attack acceleration; 8 attack strike with one empty fist extended; 9 attack follow-through; 10 recovery. Empty hands in ALL poses: actual equipment is drawn separately in game, so no weapon, tool, prop, spell or shield. Arms and fists visibly readable, natural grip-sized closed hand. Same person, same hairstyle, exact same clothing, same head size and same scale across ALL44 poses. Stable foot baseline per row. Every pose has sufficient transparent padding on all sides and between neighbours. Use the first reference only as the pose-grid template, pixel technique and chibi anatomy, not its identity/clothes. Use the second reference for the specific new person's identity and palette, but make the head and torso proportion match the third reference protagonist and the first reference. Cohesive top-down 3/4 RPG pixel sprites viewed slightly from above, same as Mosslume protagonist, about 32 logical pixels tall in game, head about 45% of visible height, body roughly18 logical pixels wide. Dark warm1px outline, deliberate square pixel clusters, minimal three-tone cel shading, no airbrush, no fine noisy photoreal texture, crisp edges. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no shadows on background, no scenery, no watermark. Genuine fully transparent background.

Preserve orange hair, cream sleeves and green outfit throughout attack too. Cheerful but restrained. Distinct from the teal protagonist.

Production game sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL Mosslume top-down RPG boss, not side-scrolling. EXACTLY FOUR rows by EIGHT columns =32 separated full-body poses on genuine transparent background. Rows top-to-bottom UP (back view; face hidden), RIGHT, DOWN(front view), LEFT. Every pose must face the correct row direction throughout windup/strike too. Columns:0 neutral ready;1 move stepA;2 move stepB;3 exaggerated anticipation/windup;4 full powerful strike;5 recovery;6 hit reaction;7 collapsed defeated corpse. Same design, head and body size for allposes, no zoom. Corpse lies down without being scaled taller. Consistent foot/ground baseline per row, plenty transparent gap; no limb/weapon clipping, no overlapping other cells. Target runtime96x96cells, visible standing figure about64-72logical pixels tall and under82wide including attached weapon. Actual game draws it at2x, roughlytwice the protagonist's height. Style same pixel density/palette technique as the reference game sprites: chunky large readable pixel clusters, warm almost-black1px contour, top-down three-quarter viewpoint with visible head top and shoulders, restrained cel shading3tones, hand-authored videogame pixel art. Not glossy high-res illustration, not side-view fighter, no realistic texture. No text, labels, grid or backdrop, no ground shadow, no opaque grey, no logos. Separate projectiles/effect overlays are generated by code; body has only attached weapon and small emissive runes.
Boss: BEACON STONE WATCHER, an original ancient forest-ruin guardian. Squat broad moss-green stone torso built from cracked chunky pale limestone blocks, huge stone forearms, narrow turquoise glowing eyes, an original crown made of three broken stone pillars of differing heights, bronze vine bindings and a luminous turquoise angular core rune on chest. Rootlets and ferns on shoulders; short heavy basalt legs, no robes or human face. Its identity is distinct from supplied tall-hat stone mage; borrow only floating-block anticipation and heavy slam gesture. Ready pose alert, move poses heavy steps. Windup raises both massive stone fists; strike slams arms forward/down; recovery draws arms back; hurt has crack-glow; death torso slumped into recognisable stone chunks. No giant explosion around sprite. Image1style reference game stone guard, Image2 motion/design inspiration user reference only, Image3 protagonist pixel palette/density. Retain four true cardinal perspectives.

Boss: MOON REAPER, an original cursed fungal woodland huntress/beast warrior. A readable large chibi humanoid forest wraith with voluminous SILVER-WHITE mane, a dark carved wooden deer mask with two short branching antlers, dark moss-green and desaturated aubergine travelling armor, small aged-gold clasps, dark brown digitigrade boots, two BONE crescent sickles gripped firmly in its hands. Turquoise-violet eyes and restrained mint highlights. Not a copy of the user reference fighter: mask, branch antlers, fungal cape and curved bone sickles define our original silhouette. Use the user reference only for anticipation, rushing blade slash and hair follow-through. Windup crosses sickles at shoulder line; strike opens both attached sickles into a sweeping diagonal slash; recover brings them beside body. Keep sickle handles connected to palms in ALL poses. Move steps have shifting mane, hurt crouches, death lies curled with dropped-close sickles. Top-down RPG proportions, not long side-view anime body. Image1style reference our mushroom beast pixel treatment, Image2 supplied blade warrior motion only, Image3 protagonist scale/pixel treatment. True UP row must show BACK of mane/cape, no front-facing mask.
